notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
